name: Elaris
description: A refined developer color theme featuring balanced contrast, cohesive syntax colors, and a minimal aesthetic for a calmer, more focused coding experience.

background.abyss.name: Forest Ink
background.abyss.description: The deepest forest-charcoal; reserved for title bars and the darkest interface surfaces.

background.sidebar.name: Deep Forest
background.sidebar.description: A deep green-black that gives sidebars and navigation areas a distinct layer.

background.editor.name: Canopy
background.editor.description: The primary editor and terminal background: dark, green-tinted, and easy on the eyes.

background.elevated.name: Moss Surface
background.elevated.description: Elevated surfaces for widgets, menus, inputs, and completion panels.

background.hover.name: Moss Hover
background.hover.description: A visible but restrained hover and active surface for interactive elements.

background.focus.name: Forest Selection
background.focus.description: A stronger green surface for focused list items and keyboard navigation.

background.selection.name: Deep Lichen Selection
background.selection.description: A translucent-ready selection color that makes selected text and items easy to identify.

border.subtle.name: Understory Border
border.subtle.description: Low-emphasis separators between panels, tabs, and editor groups.

border.strong.name: Pine Stone
border.strong.description: A stronger border for inputs, widgets, focus outlines, and resizable dividers.

text.primary.name: Soft Lichen
text.primary.description: Primary text with a soft sage cast, avoiding the glare of pure white.

text.secondary.name: Pale Sage
text.secondary.description: Secondary labels and supporting text; quieter than primary text while remaining readable.

text.muted.name: Silver Sage
text.muted.description: Comments, inactive labels, line numbers, and other low-priority information.

text.dim.name: Dusk Sage
text.dim.description: Disabled controls and the most subdued interface details.

accent.moss.name: Lichen Green
accent.moss.description: The signature Veyera accent for functions, success states, active indicators, and primary actions.

accent.teal.name: Oxidized Teal
accent.teal.description: A cool, weathered teal for properties, informational states, and secondary syntax accents.

accent.mint.name: Quiet Mint
accent.mint.description: A lighter green-blue for links, hints, constants, and subtle semantic distinctions.

accent.brass.name: Soft Brass
accent.brass.description: A warm, muted gold for types, warnings, booleans, and the editor cursor.

accent.lilac.name: Mineral Lilac
accent.lilac.description: A soft mineral purple for numbers, decorators, and select syntax accents.

accent.rose.name: Dusty Rose
accent.rose.description: A softened rose-red for errors, control-flow keywords, and destructive states.

accent.copper.name: Muted Copper
accent.copper.description: An earthy orange for operators, changed lines, tags, and event-related syntax.

accent.blue.name: Mist Blue
accent.blue.description: A cool, low-saturation blue for regular expressions and namespace-related distinctions.
